review_note: Every safe_window_days value below is derived from published referral guidance but has NOT yet been signed off by a practising clinician. AIRA must not be deployed on live patients until a named clinical reviewer has approved this file and bumped ruleset_version. Every assessment stores the ruleset_version it was made under, so decisions made before review can be identified and replayed.

sources.NG12: NICE Guideline NG12 - Suspected cancer: recognition and referral (UK). Used for referral thresholds and duration cut-offs.
sources.NTEP: India National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme - presumptive TB case definition.
sources.NP-NCD: India National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases - operational guidelines, CBAC.
sources.NCG: National Cancer Grid India - management guidelines.
sources.HAMILTON: Hamilton W. et al., positive predictive values of cancer symptoms in primary care, Br J Cancer / BMJ.

patient_phrasing.en: A cough that will not go away
patient_phrasing.hi: ऐसी खांसी जो ठीक नहीं हो रही

message.en: Your cough has lasted 14 days. In India, a cough this long means you should have a sputum test for TB. It is free at your health centre.
message.hi: आपकी खांसी 14 दिन से है। भारत में इतनी लंबी खांसी में टीबी की बलगम जांच करानी चाहिए। यह स्वास्थ्य केंद्र पर मुफ्त है।
message.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಮ್ಮು 14 ದಿನಗಳಿಂದ ಇದೆ. ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನದ ಕೆಮ್ಮಿಗೆ ಟಿಬಿ ಕಫ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಬೇಕು. ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ.

milestones.source: NTEP presumptive TB definition: cough of 2 weeks or more

message.en: Your cough has lasted 21 days. If the TB test was negative, or TB treatment did not help, ask for a chest X-ray.
message.hi: आपकी खांसी 21 दिन से है। अगर टीबी जांच नेगेटिव थी या टीबी के इलाज से फायदा नहीं हुआ, तो छाती का एक्स-रे मांगें।
message.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಮ್ಮು 21 ದಿನಗಳಿಂದ ಇದೆ. ಟಿಬಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ನೆಗೆಟಿವ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಟಿಬಿ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಫಲಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಎದೆಯ ಎಕ್ಸ್-ರೇ ಕೇಳಿ.

citation.quote: Offer an urgent chest X-ray (to be performed within 2 weeks) to assess for lung cancer in people aged 40 and over if they have 2 or more unexplained symptoms, or if they have ever smoked and have 1 or more unexplained symptoms.

patient_phrasing.en: Blood when I cough

citation.quote: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral (for an appointment within 2 weeks) for lung cancer if they are aged 40 and over with unexplained haemoptysis.

patient_phrasing.en: Getting out of breath easily

citation.quote: Qualifying unexplained symptom for lung cancer assessment in people aged 40 and over.

patient_phrasing.en: Pain in the chest

citation.quote: Qualifying unexplained symptom for lung cancer assessment in people aged 40 and over.

patient_phrasing.en: Chest infection keeps coming back
patient_phrasing.hi: छाती का संक्रमण बार-बार होता है

citation.quote: Consider an urgent chest X-ray in people aged 40 and over with persistent or recurrent chest infection.

label.en: Mouth ulcer that will not heal
label.hi: मुंह का छाला जो ठीक नहीं हो रहा

patient_phrasing.en: A sore in my mouth that has not healed
patient_phrasing.hi: मुंह में घाव जो भरा नहीं

message.en: A sore in the mouth that has not healed in 3 weeks needs to be looked at by a dentist or an ENT doctor.
message.hi: मुंह का घाव जो 3 हफ्ते में नहीं भरा, उसे दंत चिकित्सक या ईएनटी डॉक्टर को दिखाना जरूरी है।
message.kn: 3 ವಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಣವಾಗದ ಬಾಯಿ ಹುಣ್ಣನ್ನು ದಂತ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅಥವಾ ಇಎನ್‌ಟಿ ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗೆ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕು.

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for oral cancer in people with unexplained ulceration in the oral cavity lasting for more than 3 weeks.

label.en: White or red patch in mouth
label.hi: मुंह में सफेद या लाल धब्बा

patient_phrasing.en: A white or red patch inside my mouth
patient_phrasing.hi: मुंह के अंदर सफेद या लाल निशान
patient_phrasing.kn: ಬಾಯಿ ಒಳಗೆ ಬಿಳಿ ಅಥವಾ ಕೆಂಪು ಕಲೆ

citation.quote: Consider urgent referral for assessment for possible oral cancer in people with a lump on the lip or in the oral cavity, or a red or red and white patch consistent with erythroplakia or erythroleukoplakia.

patient_phrasing.en: My mouth does not open as wide as before

citation.quote: Restricted mouth opening is a recognised feature of oral submucous fibrosis, a potentially malignant disorder strongly associated with areca nut chewing and highly prevalent in India.

patient_phrasing.en: Teeth getting loose without injury

citation.quote: Unexplained tooth mobility is a recognised presenting feature of oral malignancy.

patient_phrasing.en: My voice has changed and stayed changed
patient_phrasing.hi: आवाज बदल गई है और वैसी ही है

message.en: Your voice has been hoarse for more than 3 weeks. An ENT doctor should look at your throat.
message.hi: आपकी आवाज 3 हफ्ते से ज्यादा भारी है। ईएनटी डॉक्टर को गला दिखाना चाहिए।
message.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಧ್ವನಿ 3 ವಾರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಒರಟಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಎನ್‌ಟಿ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಗಂಟಲು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬೇಕು.

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for laryngeal cancer in people aged 45 and over with persistent unexplained hoarseness.

patient_phrasing.en: A lump in my neck

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for people with an unexplained persistent lump in the neck.

patient_phrasing.en: Throat pain that keeps going
patient_phrasing.hi: गले का दर्द जो बना रहता है

citation.quote: Persistent unilateral throat discomfort beyond 4 weeks warrants ENT assessment.

patient_phrasing.en: One ear hurts and there is no infection
patient_phrasing.hi: एक कान में दर्द, संक्रमण नहीं

citation.quote: Referred otalgia with a normal ear examination is a recognised red flag for pharyngeal or laryngeal malignancy.

patient_phrasing.en: Food gets stuck when I swallow

citation.quote: Offer urgent direct access upper gastrointestinal endoscopy (to be performed within 2 weeks) to assess for oesophageal or stomach cancer in people with dysphagia.

patient_phrasing.en: Burning or heaviness in the stomach

message.en: This burning has continued for 6 weeks even with medicine. It should be tested now, not treated again.
message.hi: दवा के बावजूद यह जलन 6 हफ्ते से है। अब दोबारा दवा नहीं, जांच होनी चाहिए।
message.kn: ಔಷಧಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡರೂ ಈ ಉರಿ 6 ವಾರಗಳಿಂದ ಇದೆ. ಈಗ ಮತ್ತೆ ಔಷಧಿ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಆಗಬೇಕು.

citation.quote: Consider non-urgent direct access upper gastrointestinal endoscopy to assess for oesophageal or stomach cancer in people aged 55 or over with treatment-resistant dyspepsia.

patient_phrasing.en: I feel full after only a little food
patient_phrasing.hi: थोड़ा खाते ही पेट भर जाता है

citation.quote: Consider endoscopy in people aged 55 and over with upper abdominal pain with reflux, or with nausea or vomiting and weight loss.

patient_phrasing.en: I keep vomiting

citation.quote: Nausea or vomiting with weight loss in people aged 55 and over warrants endoscopy.

label.hi: पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में दर्द

patient_phrasing.en: Pain above my navel

citation.quote: Upper abdominal pain with reflux in people aged 55 and over is an indication for endoscopy.

label.hi: आंखों या त्वचा का पीला होना

patient_phrasing.en: My eyes have turned yellow

citation.quote: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for pancreatic cancer if they are aged 40 and over and have jaundice.

patient_phrasing.en: Blood when I pass motion

message.en: Bleeding has continued for 2 weeks. It is usually piles, but it should be examined rather than assumed.
message.hi: खून 2 हफ्ते से आ रहा है। आमतौर पर यह बवासीर होता है, पर मान लेने के बजाय जांच करानी चाहिए।
message.kn: 2 ವಾರಗಳಿಂದ ರಕ್ತಸ್ರಾವ ಇದೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಮೂಲವ್ಯಾಧಿ, ಆದರೆ ಊಹಿಸದೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬೇಕು.

citation.quote: Refer adults using a suspected cancer pathway referral for colorectal cancer if they are aged 50 and over with unexplained rectal bleeding.

label.hi: मल त्याग की आदत में बदलाव

patient_phrasing.en: My motions have changed and stayed changed
patient_phrasing.hi: शौच की आदत बदल गई है

citation.quote: Refer adults aged 60 and over with a change in bowel habit using a suspected cancer pathway referral.

patient_phrasing.en: I can feel a lump in my stomach
patient_phrasing.hi: पेट में गांठ महसूस होती है

citation.quote: Refer adults with an abdominal mass consistent with involvement of the large bowel using a suspected cancer pathway referral.

label.hi: मल पूरा न निकलने का एहसास

patient_phrasing.en: Feels like I still need to go after passing motion
patient_phrasing.hi: शौच के बाद भी लगता है जाना है

citation.quote: Tenesmus is a recognised presenting feature of rectal carcinoma.

patient_phrasing.en: I felt a lump in my breast

citation.quote: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for breast cancer if they are aged 30 and over and have an unexplained breast lump with or without pain.

patient_phrasing.en: Fluid coming from the nipple

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral in people aged 30 and over with unexplained nipple discharge.

patient_phrasing.en: My nipple has turned inward

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral in people aged 30 and over with skin changes that suggest breast cancer, including nipple retraction.

patient_phrasing.en: The skin of my breast looks different
patient_phrasing.hi: स्तन की त्वचा अलग दिख रही है

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral in people with skin changes that suggest breast cancer.

patient_phrasing.en: A lump under my arm

citation.quote: Unexplained axillary lymphadenopathy warrants assessment for breast cancer and lymphoma.

patient_phrasing.en: Bleeding started again after my periods had stopped
patient_phrasing.hi: मासिक बंद होने के बाद फिर खून आना

citation.quote: Refer women using a suspected cancer pathway referral for endometrial cancer if they are aged 55 and over with post-menopausal bleeding.

patient_phrasing.en: Bleeding after being with my husband
patient_phrasing.hi: पति के साथ होने के बाद खून आना

citation.quote: Consider urgent appointment for cervical cancer assessment in women with post-coital bleeding.

patient_phrasing.en: Bleeding at the wrong time of month

citation.quote: Unexplained intermenstrual bleeding requires assessment for cervical and endometrial pathology.

patient_phrasing.en: Discharge with a bad smell

citation.quote: Persistent offensive vaginal discharge unresponsive to treatment requires speculum examination to exclude cervical malignancy.

label.hi: पेट के निचले हिस्से में दर्द

patient_phrasing.en: Pain low down in my stomach

citation.quote: Carry out tests in primary care if a woman reports persistent or frequent abdominal distension, early satiety, pelvic or abdominal pain, occurring more than 12 times per month.

patient_phrasing.en: My stomach feels bloated most days
patient_phrasing.hi: ज्यादातर दिन पेट फूला रहता है

citation.quote: Persistent abdominal distension in women, particularly aged 50 and over, should prompt testing for ovarian cancer.

patient_phrasing.en: Blood when I pass urine

citation.quote: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for bladder cancer if they are aged 45 and over and have unexplained visible haematuria.

patient_phrasing.en: Trouble starting or a weak stream

citation.quote: Consider a prostate specific antigen test and digital rectal examination to assess for prostate cancer in men with lower urinary tract symptoms.

patient_phrasing.en: A lump in my testicle

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for testicular cancer in men with a non-painful enlargement or change in shape or texture of the testis.

patient_phrasing.en: I do not feel like eating

citation.quote: Appetite loss is a qualifying unexplained symptom for lung cancer assessment in people aged 40 and over, and appears across upper gastrointestinal referral criteria.

patient_phrasing.en: Losing weight without trying
patient_phrasing.hi: बिना कोशिश के वजन कम होना

message.en: You have been losing weight for a month without trying. This needs blood tests and a scan.
message.hi: आपका वजन बिना कोशिश के एक महीने से घट रहा है। इसके लिए खून की जांच और स्कैन जरूरी है।
message.kn: ಒಂದು ತಿಂಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ತೂಕ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ರಕ್ತ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನ್ ಬೇಕು.

citation.quote: Unexplained weight loss is a recognised feature across multiple cancer sites and appears in the referral criteria for lung, upper GI, colorectal, pancreatic and haematological cancers.

patient_phrasing.en: Tired all day even after resting
patient_phrasing.hi: आराम के बाद भी दिनभर थकान

citation.quote: Fatigue is a qualifying unexplained symptom for lung cancer assessment and a common presenting feature of haematological malignancy.

patient_phrasing.en: Fever that keeps returning

message.en: The fever has lasted more than 2 weeks. Ask for a blood count test before taking any more antibiotics.
message.hi: बुखार 2 हफ्ते से ज्यादा है। और एंटीबायोटिक लेने से पहले खून की जांच (सीबीसी) मांगें।
message.kn: ಜ್ವರ 2 ವಾರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದೆ. ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಆ್ಯಂಟಿಬಯೋಟಿಕ್ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಮೊದಲು ರಕ್ತ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಕೇಳಿ.

milestones.source: Field research: CanKids KidsCan reported repeated anti-typhoid and anti-malarial courses given without a CBC ever being done.

citation.quote: Offer a full blood count within 48 hours to assess for leukaemia in adults with unexplained fever, and consider very urgent referral in children.

patient_phrasing.en: Sweating so much at night my clothes get wet
patient_phrasing.hi: रात में इतना पसीना कि कपड़े भीग जाएं

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for Hodgkin lymphoma in people presenting with night sweats.

patient_phrasing.en: Swollen glands that have not gone down

citation.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for non-Hodgkin lymphoma in people with unexplained lymphadenopathy.

patient_phrasing.en: Looking pale and feeling weak

citation.quote: Offer testing for iron deficiency anaemia; unexplained iron deficiency anaemia is an indication for colorectal investigation.

patient_phrasing.en: Bone pain that does not stop
patient_phrasing.hi: हड्डी का दर्द जो नहीं रुकता

citation.quote: Consider a very urgent direct access X-ray in children and young people with unexplained bone swelling or pain.

patient_phrasing.en: Bruises appear without injury

citation.quote: Offer a very urgent full blood count to assess for leukaemia in adults with unexplained bruising.

patient_phrasing.en: A wound on my skin that has not healed
patient_phrasing.hi: त्वचा पर घाव जो नहीं भरा

citation.quote: Consider referral for people with a skin lesion that raises the suspicion of squamous cell carcinoma.

patient_phrasing.en: A mole that has changed shape or colour
patient_phrasing.hi: तिल का आकार या रंग बदलना

citation.quote: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for melanoma if they have a suspicious pigmented skin lesion with a weighted 7-point checklist score of 3 or more.

patient_phrasing.en: A lump in my child's stomach

citation.quote: Consider a very urgent referral for children with a palpable abdominal mass or unexplained enlarged abdominal organ.

patient_phrasing.en: Headache that keeps getting worse
patient_phrasing.hi: सिरदर्द जो बढ़ता जा रहा है

citation.quote: Consider an urgent direct access MRI scan of the brain in adults with progressive, sub-acute loss of central neurological function.

combination_rules.label: Lung: age 40+, ever smoked, one or more qualifying symptom

citation.quote: Offer an urgent chest X-ray in people aged 40 and over if they have ever smoked and have 1 or more unexplained symptoms.

combination_rules.label: Lung: age 40+, two or more qualifying symptoms (any smoking status)

citation.quote: Offer an urgent chest X-ray in people aged 40 and over if they have 2 or more unexplained symptoms.

combination_rules.label: Upper GI: age 55+, weight loss with upper abdominal symptoms

citation.quote: Offer urgent direct access upper gastrointestinal endoscopy in people aged 55 and over with weight loss and any of: upper abdominal pain, reflux, dyspepsia.

combination_rules.label: Colorectal: weight loss or anaemia with bowel symptoms

citation.quote: Refer adults using a suspected cancer pathway referral for colorectal cancer if they have unexplained weight loss with abdominal pain, or iron-deficiency anaemia with a change in bowel habit.

combination_rules.label: Oral: any oral lesion in a tobacco or areca user

citation.quote: Any persistent oral mucosal lesion in a tobacco or areca nut user should be regarded as potentially malignant until proven otherwise. India accounts for approximately one third of the global oral cancer burden.
Consider urgent assessment for cervical cancer in women with abnormal bleeding, particularly when accompanied by abnormal discharge.

combination_rules.label: Paediatric: prolonged fever with pallor or bruising

citation.quote: Offer a very urgent full blood count to assess for leukaemia in children with any of: pallor, persistent fatigue, unexplained fever, unexplained persistent infection, generalised lymphadenopathy, persistent or unexplained bone pain, unexplained bruising.
